{
 "path": "programs/task-86cabfb9.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Remove scattered marker colors and regularize the large solid objects.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]; bg=grid[0][0]
    # hand-classify largest repeated-color rectangles by connected components,
    # then fill enclosed holes and remove small stray components.
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for y in range(h):
      for x in range(w):
        c=grid[y][x]
        if c==bg or (y,x) in seen: continue
        q=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); cells=[]
        while q:
          a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
          for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            aa,bb=a+da,b+db
            if 0<=aa<h and 0<=bb<w and (aa,bb) not in seen and grid[aa][bb]==c:
              seen.add((aa,bb));q.append((aa,bb))
        comps.append((c,cells))
    # Components of at least four pixels are intentional shapes. Their bbox
    # is filled only when it is a near-rectangle (at least 70% occupancy).
    large=[]
    for c,cells in comps:
      if len(cells)<4: continue
      ys=[p[0] for p in cells];xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
      y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
      area=(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)
      large.append((c,cells,y0,y1,x0,x1))
      if len(cells)/area>=.70:
        for y in range(y0,y1+1):
          for x in range(x0,x1+1): out[y][x]=c
    # Delete small anomalous components, unless they touch a large shape's
    # bbox; in that case it is an embedded defect and take that shape's color.
    for c,cells in comps:
      if len(cells)>=4: continue
      for y,x in cells:
        matches=[obj for obj in large if obj[2]<=y<=obj[3] and obj[4]<=x<=obj[5]]
        if matches: out[y][x]=matches[0][0]
        else: out[y][x]=bg
    return out
"
}
